liquid_rules.reason: Liquids are measured by volume (ml/L), not weight

food_solid_rules.description: For solid food products (rice, flour, sugar, spices, coffee, tea, snacks)
food_solid_rules.reason: Solid foods are measured by weight (g/kg), not volume

furniture_rules.description: For furniture (cupboard, cabinet, table, chair, sofa, bed)
furniture_rules.reason: Furniture uses actual measurements in cm, not S/M/L sizes

clothing_rules.description: For clothing (shirt, t-shirt, pants, dress, jacket)
clothing_rules.reason: Clothing uses standard sizes (S/M/L/XL), not dimensions

electronic_rules.reason: Electronics use technical specs, not weight/volume

jewelry_rules.reason: Jewelry uses specific measurements, not generic sizes

shoes_rules.reason: Shoes use standard sizing, not physical dimensions

book_rules.reason: Books are identified by metadata, not physical variants

plant_rules.reason: Plants are identified by botanical characteristics

pet_rules.reason: Pet products are sized by animal characteristics

tool_rules.reason: Tools are identified by technical specifications

digital_product_rules.reason: Digital products have no physical properties
